items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a homomorphism of sheaves of rings A -> B on a site C, the cohomology sheaf H^i(L_{B/A}) is the sheaf associated to the presheaf U -> H^i(L_{B(U)/A(U)}) (source lines 3414-3420). The proof transports the statement to the site with the chaotic topology, where presheaves are sheaves: the inclusion of sheaves into presheaves together with sheafification forms a morphism of topoi, and the pullback statement for the cotangent complex along a morphism of topoi reduces the claim to the chaotic case. There the statement follows because the diagram comparing algebras over A with the category of sheaves, and algebras over the ring of sections A(U) with sets, commutes, so the value of the complex on U is exactly the sectionwise complex.
